fieldNotes.truckGate: Street View shows a brick plant wall with silos and a tight paved apron against the street - no barrier arm or checkpoint visible. Open/uncontrolled entrance read.
fieldNotes.backupSensitive: Older plant hemmed in by residential streets on all sides; a truck queue would spill directly onto neighborhood roads with little stacking room.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Plant embedded in a dense downtown/residential city core - Urban.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Small dedicated trailer parking lot to the southwest holding parked trailers.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Limited dock frontage; few doors resolvable on the cramped site.
